description: Write a cover letter (motivation letter) from one of the user's CVs and a job description, in the conventions of the CV's country. PRO and AI consent. Use when the user needs a cover letter for a specific job. Returns {result, cacheKey} or a plan gate.

cvId.description: The id of the CV to use (get it from list_my_takemeup_cvs).

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

name: generate_takemeup_cover_letter
title: Cover letter (PRO)
